value.name: Asha realizes she revealed too much
value.description: Asha understands from Daniel's delayed reaction that her question has already given away something she meant to hide.
evidence: did not answer at once, and in that pause Asha understood that the question itself had told him something she had not meant to give away yet

value.name: Rosa redirects Daniel's attention
value.description: Rosa steps closer and points out a pale ring on the sideboard to pull Daniel's gaze away from the hidden panel.
evidence: Rosa moved a half step toward Daniel and lifted the cloth so it pointed at a pale ring on the leaf of the sideboard
the question pulled Daniel's gaze down to the wood she wanted him to see, away from the panel at Asha's hip

value.name: Asha opens the hidden panel
value.description: Using Rosa's distraction, Asha slips her hand into the gap and opens the concealed panel slightly.
evidence: Under cover of that small redirection Asha let her palm slide back along the polished top, fingers slipping into the gap, and eased the panel open another finger's width

value.name: Asha finds folded papers
value.description: Asha feels the dry edge of folded paper inside the panel and pulls the pages out.
evidence: until she felt the dry edge of folded paper inside
She drew the pages out flat against her sleeve

value.name: Asha hides the papers in her jacket
value.description: Asha tucks the stolen pages into her inside jacket pocket while keeping Daniel's attention elsewhere.
evidence: and tucked them into the inside pocket of her jacket in one slow motion
keeping her face turned toward Daniel as if she were only waiting for his answer about the deeds

value.name: Daniel fails to notice the theft
value.description: When Daniel looks up, he notices Asha's hand on the wood but not the papers she has hidden.
evidence: When he finally looked up from the watermark his eyes went to her hand on the wood and not to her pocket

value.name: Asha estimates Daniel's delayed suspicion
value.description: Asha realizes she has only a few hours before Daniel thinks back and notices what she took.
evidence: she understood she had perhaps a few hours before he thought back through the morning and realized what he had not seen

value.name: Rosa questions Daniel about the ring
value.description: Rosa presses Daniel to remember who left the pale ring, shifting the conversation toward a night in his mother's house.
evidence: Rosa did not give the moment back to Daniel
She stepped in nearer the leaf and tapped the pale ring with one fingertip, asking him if he remembered who had left it
because it asked him to account for a night in his mother's house
